'''''Touch of Gold''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was operated by the [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] agent [[Donari Caron]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In about [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], Caron docked the vessel in [[Westport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and she brokered a deal with the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Black market/Legends|black market]] [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] [[Acer Ash]] while aboard the ship, to exchange a painting she had recovered for an experimental [[Ray shield/Legends|energy shield]] that Ash possessed.
